component.name: Orbit
component.summary: Control panel for the COSMIC panel

description.p: Quick toggles, sliders, a calendar with your synced events and a dynamic island for what's playing, filming or recording — in one popup on your COSMIC panel, following your theme.

ul.li: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, VPN, power mode, do not disturb, dark style, airplane mode, microphone, keep awake, tiling, accessibility and touchpad tiles, with detail pages
Drag to reorder tiles, make them wide or small, show their icons on the panel
Volume with output picker, and screen brightness
Month calendar with events from GNOME Online Accounts calendars
Media controls, and which apps use the camera or microphone
VPN and Wi-Fi passwords from the keyring, or asked in the popup
Opens as a dropdown, side panel or fullscreen; one surface or separate islands

screenshot.caption: Quick settings, sliders, calendar and media in one popup
Fullscreen, as separate islands, with the month open

description.p: Cover art in the media island, calendar days in the text color, screenshots.
